item.title: Saturday Morning Ride: High Park to the Brickworks Market loop — Sat Sep 19, 9:30 AM
item.description:
The ride starts from the parking lot at the Grenadier Restaurant in High Park (about 1km south of the Bloor St entrance). NOTE: There is no car access to the interior of the park , so, if you drive to the start, allow time to arrive on schedule. The route weaves its way north and east across town to the Beltway and down to the Brickworks for a snack stop (and shopping?). The route includes some gravel paths. The return is via some downtown bike lanes and the Lakeshore trail to High Park. About 45kms- should finish about 1:30pm. This is an Urban Roller level ride. item.title: Surviving Dementia Care: The Realities of Family Caregiving — Mon Sep 28, 6:30 PM — Gerrard/Ashdale
item.description: Are you a caregiver for someone with dementia? This talk addresses the specific experiences of people who are caring for a loved one, including the points of stress, the points of joy, and ways in which caregivers learn to survive the experience. Learn about understanding the diagnosis, communicating with the loved one, managing guilt and grief, choosing an assisted living facility, using music and the arts as a means of connection and how the loving bond within the family can be maintained for as long as possible. Presented by D. Grant Campbell, author of Surviving Dementia Care (University of Toronto Press, 2026). D. Grant Campbell is a Professor Emeritus of Library and Information Science in the Faculty of Information and Media Studies, at the University of Western Ontario in London, Ontario.
